answer_reference_text: Prior to RetinaNet, one-stage detectors like SSD and YOLO were faster than two-stage detectors like Faster R-CNN but consistently less accurate. RetinaNet introduced Focal Loss to address the extreme foreground-background class imbalance during training of dense one-stage detectors, which was identified as the primary reason for their accuracy gap. With Focal Loss, RetinaNet achieved accuracy surpassing all existing two-stage detectors while maintaining the speed advantage of one-stage methods.
